summary: Duplex: plumbing shift allowed; broad exculpation void; third-party-crime clause fine; 12h entry notice.

findings.quote: Lessor may enter the premises to make repairs after giving Lessee at least 12 hours' notice, between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m.
Lessor shall not be liable to Lessee, Lessee's family, or guests for any damage, injury, or loss to person or property from any cause whatsoever, including Lessor's own negligence.

outOfScope.quote: One cat is permitted. Dogs are not allowed.

nearMisses.quote: Lessee agrees in writing to make and pay for repairs to the plumbing serving the east unit, including the water heater.
Lessor is not responsible for loss or damage caused by the criminal acts of third parties, including burglary and vandalism.
nearMisses.note: label policy row 8: third-party crime only
